name: @w6w-apps/omnisend
description: Omnisend contacts, tagging, and customer events for ecommerce email/SMS marketing automation.

w6w.longDescription:
Omnisend manages the ecommerce marketing lifecycle from a workflow — creating and updating contacts, tagging them individually or in bulk by ID, email, phone, or segment, and sending the customer events (recommended events like "placed order", or free-form custom events) that trigger Omnisend's own automations, segments, and reporting.

A fit for syncing storefront data (contacts, orders) into Omnisend as it happens, or triggering an Omnisend automation from an external condition detected elsewhere in a workflow.
